messages:
maya: Heads-up — during the ortolan11b int4 canary we saw a weird latency regression in staging after enabling aggressive prefetch.  P95 jumped from ~120ms to ~420ms for short chats and there's one OOM in the logs.

sam: ack. do we have a repro? small prompt that triggers?

julia: I fuzzed with the small QA suite. Repro steps: load model, set prefetch=3, slot_reserve=0.05, batch_max_tokens=2048, send 1-2 short queries (<=32 tokens). 90% of requests fine, but occasional 2-3s tail.

maya: exact config we rolled:
```
model: ortolan11b-int4
prefetch: 3
slot_reserve: 0.05
kv_eviction_hysteresis: 0.12
batching:
  batch_max_tokens: 2048
  max_concurrent_batches: 6
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 128
```

maya: logs show many small allocations and repeated eviction/rehydration cycles for the KV cache. suspect fragmentation + prefetch causing repeated mem churn.

irene: can you paste the OOM snippet?

maya: sure — from the serving node: ```OOM on device 0: allocate 1.2GB
Allocation failed: out of memory
KVCache compaction triggered: freed 0.0MB -> unable to satisfy request```

devon: that "freed 0.0MB" line is interesting — compactor not reclaiming due to tiny live fragments. I've seen this when slot_reserve is too low and prefetch pulls in many short KV ranges.

sam: hypothesis: prefetch=3 + low slot_reserve causes a lot of ephemeral slots; compactor can't coalesce so the allocator can't fit the next big allocation -> tail latency + occasional OOM.

julia: agrees. Also noticed kernel selection shifts under high fragmentation — runtime picks small-kernel path more often which increases per-token latency.

perf-bot: perf regression alert — ortolan11b-int4 staging: P95 +250ms vs baseline (24h). Regression correlates with prefetch toggle at 2026-03-17T18:42Z.

irene: cheap mitigation to test in staging: reduce prefetch to 1 and bump slot_reserve to 0.12. Also set kv_eviction_hysteresis to 0.25 to reduce churn.

maya: I'll run that now on a canary pool (3 nodes).

(30m later)

maya: canary logs after change: p95 back to ~140ms, no OOMs in 1h smoke. Memory compaction reports: freed ~320MB across nodes.

sam: nice. any quality impact from changing those knobs?

julia: no visible quality delta in our eval set. prefetch from 3->1 increases cold-start latency slightly for long sessions, but common short chats benefit.

devon: long-term we should add a fragmentation-aware prefetch policy: only prefetch up to an absolute slot budget per-request (e.g., prefetch_slots_budget=8) and fall back to prioritized-range prefetch. Also expose a compaction defrag pass during low-load windows.

irene: +1. Also suggest a guard: if compactor frees < X MB in last Y minutes while allocations keep failing, raise slot_reserve automatically and temporarily ramp down prefetch.

maya: action items: 1) keep canary with prefetch=1, slot_reserve=0.12, hysteresis=0.25 2) add a short perf test to run 10k short queries and capture kernel-path distribution 3) engineering ticket for adaptive-prefetch + compactor guard.

sam: design note for ticket: include metrics: compactor_freed_bytes, allocation_failures, kernel_path (small/large), p95 per-route, prefetch_slots_used.

julia: I'll own the perf test (w/ scripts) and run overnight regression tests.

devon: I'll sketch the adaptive-prefetch RFC and a naive autoscaler that raises slot_reserve on repeated compaction failures.

maya: thanks all. if canary stays clean we'll push to staging tomorrow and monitor. :thumbsup:
